rv.q: The excellent cast and Met Opera Orchestra under the inspired conducting of Nicholas Carter presented an unforgettable revival, rich in emotional details.
All in all, it is a pleasure to see this masterpiece back at the house and one hopes the company can fill the auditorium for the next five performances.

The Metropolitan Opera’s run of Arabella opened Monday night, with a cast dotted with auspicious company debuts in roles from Arabella’s sister to her three unsuccessful suitors to the cabbies’ mascot, the party girl referred to only as the Fiakermilli.

cn.t: Critics praise this underperformed Strauss gem for its nostalgic charm and intimate character portrayal, with an outstanding cast bringing the romantic comedy's beautiful score to life at the Met.
